description: Risk-controlled diversified trend book. At each month-end hold 1/5 of capital in each of SPY, EFA, IEF, GLD, VNQ for every one of the 8-, 10- and 12-month simple moving averages its last close is above (a fraction of the three); unallocated capital is held in SHY (short-term Treasuries). Backtest 2007-2026 with 10bp per side: 5.3% a year, vol 7.8%, Sharpe 0.70, max drawdown -14.5% versus SPY buy and hold 11.0%, 0.63, -55%. It reduces risk; it is expected to lag SPY in strong bull markets. No profit claim. See research/review_2026_10_05/TREND_RESEARCH.md.

risk.note: Drawdown measured on end-of-day equity vs running peak. Pause blocks new single-stock entries; halt liquidates everything and blocks all buys (for the live 30-day experiment this effectively means cash until the end).

costs.note: Per-side cost applied as an adverse price adjustment (buys fill higher, sells lower). Covers half-spread plus slippage; deliberately conservative for liquid large caps.
